rule.withinMetric: Equal case weight. Credit only for all case criteria supported by actual matching-build evidence and independent review.
rule.overall: Sum(metric weight * passed/total). Missing, blocked, failed, invalid, skipped and not-run earn zero. Incomplete score is capped below 100.
rule.completion: Every metric must be 100; an aggregate average cannot waive a case. Platform limits and missing human input remain open.
rule.meaning: Zero evidence-backed score is not a conclusion that the product has zero functionality.

scoring.interpretation: No entire frozen original case is independently closed by the supplied evidence at this checkpoint. Zero is whole-case evidence completeness, not implementation quality or a denial of the successful engine, transport, RemoteInput and build results. Partial case evidence receives no numeric credit under the frozen rule.
scoring.reasonNoCheckerRun: This is the requested independent adversarial review, not a fabricated all-pass submission. No builds/tests or new audit framework were run.

pendingEffectInspection.directComparison: The actual task contains original SPEC verbatim and ARTIFACTS stdout consisting of a diffstat, frozen acceptance README/baseline/checker/freeze/matrix/verification. Their embedded text matches the files exactly. Baseline/checker self-tests establish no product acceptance. Final evidence was separately opened and inspected directly; narrative claims in context were not substituted for logs, captured bytes or original criteria.
